notes:
This is author page 40, a continuation, with two displayed formulas and no diagram or drawing. The top two lines conclude that, under finite generation over Q and Mordell-Weil-Néron, Pic(S) is finitely generated and map (18) is injective. The author then sets that condition aside and says the class c (14) is the image in (18) of gamma_i in Pic(S), the class of the conormal (or normal: his explicit parenthetical doubt le diable sait) sheaf of X along g_i. He sketches taking the formal completion along g_i(S), opening/removing g_i(S), and interpreting (13) as a homotopy exact sequence of a constructed topos over S. The ending reads On a donc à prouver une histoire d'ombres. These mathematical statements are recorded, not independently established here; no neighbouring page or external source was used. Whole image viewed once, each full-resolution half once; every baseline word and display compared to C and H. Every existing deletion and insertion was rechecked for its extent/attachment. Twenty main baseline rows are counted, including two displays, excluding the three interlinear insertions and two isolated numbers. All mandatory word differences and resolvable C marks have crops; additional crops cover the proper name insertion, the author's normal/conormal parenthesis, and the four struck doubts. The opening insertion attaches after fini through its long bracket/leader; module replaces only groupe. The (14) curved leader is not punctuation. The author's explicit conormal/normal uncertainty is not editorial uncertainty. After blind adjudication, the struck words groupe, pour, de, le, schéma and Spec remain doubtful because their covered letters cannot all be resolved. Live qui ouvre and monté remain doubtful. No OCR or text recognition was used. No compilation was performed.

Main-reader check 081-N1: conditional on Pic(S) being a finitely generated abelian group, the map to its completion is injective. Indeed, the free coordinates in an element lying in every nA vanish, and the finite torsion component vanishes on taking n divisible by its exponent. This does not prove the page’s geometric finite-generation premise or its comparison with H²(S,T). The root viewed all twelve crops and the full page and accepted the remaining reading doubts.

Final blind adjudication adds doubts to cancelled groupe and schéma because their internal letters cannot all be separated from the strike. The primary readings remain unchanged. Other proposed changes (d’où, induit, obtient with an E/gamma formula, pointé, en dessus, On e, pousser/penser) were checked on the second crops and rejected or covered by the existing local doubts; the recorded crop decisions give the individual strokes.
